title: Why Bodies Need to Move
thumbnailPrompt: A human figure suspended in a dreamlike space, composed of swirling galaxies and abstract neural networks, illuminated by soft, ethereal light. Emphasize the interconnectedness of the cosmos and the human brain. High-end documentary style, cinematic lighting, photorealistic.
infographicPrompts: Diagram illustrating the relationship between physical movement, brain activity, and the quality of sleep. Show arrows indicating how exercise improves sleep, which in turn enhances cognitive function. Clean, modern style, high-contrast background.
